reason: The lift module needs a mount before it can be fitted inside the open frame.
expectation: The mount will provide a padded attachment for the lift module.

effect: The frame now has a module mount, so the lift module can likely be fitted before the skin.
reaction: The attachment point is in place; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The chapter explicitly says to fit the lift module while the ribs are open.
expectation: The lift module will attach to the padded mount inside the whale.

effect: The lift module is fitted, leaving the skin and service hatch to add.
reason: With the module in place, the paper skin can cover the frame.
expectation: The skin will cover the whale while leaving access for the service hatch.

effect: The whale is skinned; the service hatch and its button pushrod remain to be fitted.
reaction: The covering went on as expected.
reason: The service hatch should restore access to the lift module through the skin.
expectation: The hatch will fit into the skin and provide access to the module.

effect: The hatch provides access to the controller and counterweight; the pushrod remains to be fitted.
reaction: Keeping the adjustments accessible makes the hatch's purpose clear.
reason: The pushrod should connect the hatch button to the lift module's stop switch.
expectation: The pushrod will make the power-cut switch reachable from outside the whale.

effect: The pushrod completed the exterior stop button, and the chapter's goal is complete. The result also explained how the low battery and counterweight are positioned beneath the lift.
reaction: The accessible stop and low-hanging weight made the finished arrangement feel purposeful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the service hatch was most worthwhile: it showed how a finished covering can still leave the controller and counterweight accessible for adjustment.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the mount and module was predictable progress, with little explanation at the time beyond the resulting names.

surprise.text: The final result clarified that the battery and counterweight sit low beneath the lift, adding a useful detail about the arrangement.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary; the chapter's instructions and the parts made their purposes reasonably clear.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the completed whale and its attractions work together, although this chapter's assembly was mostly predictable.
